constraints.name: employment_contract_business_rate_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((tax_treatment = 'BUSINESS_INCOME'::text) AND (business_deduction_rate IS NOT NULL) AND (business_deduction_rate >= (0)::numeric) AND (business_deduction_rate <= (1)::numeric)) OR ((tax_treatment = 'FOUR_INSURANCE'::text) AND (business_deduction_rate IS NULL))))

constraints.name: employment_contract_night_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((night_allowance_enabled = false) AND (night_allowance_mode IS NULL) AND (night_allowance_value IS NULL)) OR ((night_allowance_enabled = true) AND (night_allowance_mode = ANY (ARRAY['RATE'::text, 'FLAT'::text])) AND (night_allowance_value IS NOT NULL) AND (night_allowance_value >= (0)::numeric))))

constraints.name: employment_contract_wage_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((payroll_type = 'HOURLY'::text) AND (hourly_wage IS NOT NULL) AND (hourly_wage > 0) AND (monthly_salary IS NULL)) OR ((payroll_type = 'MONTHLY'::text) AND (monthly_salary IS NOT NULL) AND (monthly_salary > 0) AND (hourly_wage IS NULL))))
